name: AKARI Keymaster
description: Non-disclosing credential agent for approved Vault path discovery, availability checks, and credential health checks via A2A.

keymasterBearer.description: Per-agent Bearer token issued from Keymaster admin. Scoped read-only. No Vault write access is granted.

skills.name: Secret Status
skills.description: Check whether an approved credential is available without returning its value.

skills.name: List Services
skills.description: Enumerate all service/key-name pairs registered in Vault, and whether each key can be verified against its upstream API. Useful for workflow planning before a job starts.

skills.name: List Secrets
skills.description: Enumerate approved credential paths in service/key_name form. Suitable for audit-safe discovery before a multi-step pipeline.

skills.name: Health Check
skills.description: Validate all known credentials against their upstream service APIs before agents begin critical work. Returns a structured report with valid/invalid/error counts.

skills.name: Rotate Secret (Guidance)
skills.description: When a credential must be changed, directs the operator to the Fly-authenticated one-time localhost intake. The MCP agent remains read-only.

examples.output: Open the private one-time key post; enter the replacement only in its browser form.

authenticationNote: This agent is read-only and non-disclosing. MCP responses never contain credential values. Rotation uses a separate Fly-authenticated private intake and a one-time localhost browser form.
